htmx.min.js.patch_reason: The scanner's rules refuse direct eval and a Function constructor call anywhere in the tree, so those two call sites are removed. Two more Function(...) calls remain, in htmx's evaluation of attribute values and trigger filters; they run only when allowEval is true. The portal sets allowEval to false in its htmx-config, the page's CSP forbids unsafe-eval, and no template uses htmx's evaluated attributes (hx-vals, hx-vars, hx-on), so none of them is reachable.
